Plot the tracks of one cell

Source: R/plot_cells.R
plot_cell_tracks.Rd

Three stacked tracks on a concatenated genome axis:

  • depth log2 ratio (grey: 1 Mb windows; black: agg windows) with the expected log2 of the fitted segments;

  • oriented B-allele fraction (agg windows, point size by the number of molecule votes) with the expected major / minor fractions (none on haploid chromosomes);

  • a ribbon of the fitted nA:nB states (labelled when longer than 20 Mb), with segments confirmed in the cell outlined.

Usage

plot_cell_tracks(
  tracks,
  cell,
  ylim_log2 = c(-2, 2),
  min_hap = 3,
  raster = TRUE,
  base_size = 11
)

Arguments

tracks

cell_tracks() output

cell

cell barcode

ylim_log2

limits of the log2 track (points outside are squished onto the border)

min_hap

minimal number of molecule votes of a BAF point

raster

rasterise the 1 Mb points (ggrastr)

base_size

base font size

Value

a patchwork object

Details

Segments are coloured by state label; inherited segments are dashed, confirmed and clone (neutral) segments solid. Needs ggplot2 and patchwork (ggrastr, when installed, rasterises the 1 Mb points; when it cannot rasterise here, e.g. without a working Cairo, the points are drawn unrasterised, with one message per session).
